messages:
Nora (CS): Quick capture from BrightMap onboarding call. They surfaced 3 product asks + an embedding inconsistency. Renewal check-in in 4 weeks; finance needs a cost artifact.

Jin (CS): Can you itemize? Ill put into the account log.

Nora (CS): Items:
- Ask 1 (URGENT): downloadable per-route cost summary (CSV: route, model, tokens, computed cost) — finance blocking renewal
- Ask 2: team-shared prompt presets (scoped to workspace/team)
- Ask 3: route-level model pin/lock for controlled experiments
Bug: embeddings for two routes look unusually similar; they provided vector samples. Link: https://files.redwood/brightmap/embed-issue.png

Ava (Solutions): For the CSV, they want our computed cost only (no raw provider rates). Also asked for a single-sheet export for FP&A. Any PII concerns?

Nora (CS): No PII in payloads. They insisted on one consolidated spreadsheet mapping tokens->cost.

Tom (PM): I'll raise tickets and mark renewal-risk. Priorities: P0 cost export, P1 presets, P2 pin. Need eng estimate for P0 by Thu.

SupportBot: Ticket CS-4819 created for "BrightMap per-route cost export" by Tom https://tracker.redwood/CS-4819

Diego (Product): Jin/Nora please capture a tiny repro for embeddings and preprocessing diffs; ping eng-ml with trace id 0x4af2 if present.

Jin (CS): Will upload a notebook with sample inputs + vectors by EOD.

Nora (CS): Customer requested a stopgap: Support can send daily aggregated CSV exports until product change ships (buys ~3 weeks).

Ava (Solutions): I'll mock a CSV schema that shows computed cost columns but omits provider line items; post by 5pm and tag security.

Tom (PM): Adding follow-up task CS-4820 for "model pin toggle" (low effort). Assigning Diego to scope.

SupportBot: Ticket CS-4820 created for "Model pin toggle (BrightMap)" by Tom https://tracker.redwood/CS-4820

Nora (CS): Scheduling BrightMap follow-up for next Tue 10am PT — need a rough estimate to report. Thanks everyone, will update after the call.
